applicationPrompt:
これまでに作ったシーン画像を組み合わせた、動画の最後に表示するサムネイルを作成。
使用中のキャラクターも必ず使い、見た目を参照素材に合わせる。
「漫画」＋マンガの名前を大きく読みやすいロゴとして配置する。
prompt:
Use case: compositing / illustration-story.
Asset type: final manga-introduction video thumbnail and ending card, ONE landscape 16:9 image, requested 1920×1080.
Primary request: combine the existing scene images with the actual presenter character; make the Japanese manga title very large, bold and immediately readable.
Input images and roles: Image 1 is TITLE TYPOGRAPHY reference: preserve the exceptionally bold navy/cobalt lettering, thick white outline, fine gold accent and blue shadow. Image 2 is the actual approved snow background. Image 3 is an existing cafe scene with a black-haired boy and brown-haired cafe girl, use as a warm collage panel. Image 4 is an existing close cafe scene of the same brown-haired girl with tray, use as a second recognizable collage panel; retain her appearance. Image 5 is the ACTUAL PRESENTER CHARACTER identity reference, a little purple-haired animal-eared chibi girl in a white and purple kimono-style top, brown pleated skirt and pale purple legs; MUST include this character recognizably and faithfully with the same proportions, hair, ears, large eyes, clothes and color scheme. Keep her distinct as a sticker-like chibi presenter, never turn her into the brown-haired cafe girl.
Composition: polished cohesive thumbnail montage. Snow scenery forms the main backdrop, two softly bordered or gently blended warm cafe image panels at the lower/background edges establish the story. Put the presenter character prominently in the rightmost quarter, full-body, about 75% image height, all ears and feet visible; add a clean white sticker outline for readability. The title dominates the left and center about 72% width, very large EXTRA-HEAVY Japanese lettering, huge high-contrast thick white outline; title in three stacked lines, exactly:
それは、
降り積もる
雪のような。
Also include the exact genre word 「漫画」 in a large clearly readable warm-red badge above the title. The combined written content must be exactly 漫画　それは、降り積もる雪のような。 with no additional words. Preserve the exact punctuation. The title should be the first thing read and remain legible at small thumbnail size, near edge-to-edge within its area. All letters fully visible within 4% safe margins. Arrange collage imagery behind/below text without obscuring it and without distracting from lettering or the presenter.
Style: match the existing romantic anime-painted snow and warm amber cafe imagery, harmonious navy blue, white and warm gold; crisp confident typography. No other text, no watermark, no new character, no invented title, no extra limbs. This is a single finished composite, not a reference sheet.
